sn7.4:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn7.4:1.3: bhāradvājagotto kira brāhmaṇo samaṇassa gotamassa santike agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitoti kupito anattamano yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tuṇhībhūto ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
sn7.4:1.4: atha kho bhagavā bilaṅgikabhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya bilaṅgikabhāradvājaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
sn7.4:3.1: evaṃ vutte bilaṅgikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn7.4:3.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama. pe. esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca labheyyāhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ. pe. tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti
sn7.4:3.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosīti.
